note: SCG I.2 n.4 names natural reason as that 'cui omnes assentire coguntur', invoked against Muslims and pagans who share no Scripture: scholastic usage of natural reason as reason shared with outsiders, non-theists included. Gap: Aquinas is a theologian of the practice, not its council; that Vatican I's 'naturali humanae rationis lumine' has his sense is the reading step.
